name: Guttesen's snub-square glider in Life
description: H. S. Guttesen's period-8 glider (arXiv:2608.27622, Fig. 5) on the snub square tiling 3.3.4.3.4 in Conway's Life, B3/S23: 8 to 15 cells, moving 2 lattice steps every 8 generations (c/4). JETCARP's soup searches found it independently (77,361 times); the identification with Guttesen's figure is by eye, since his configurations are not yet published.
